title: Business Intelligence & Data Solutions Expert Lead
full_description:
Financial Markets Client Control (FMCC) is a department within Financial Markets (FM) (part of ING Wholesale Banking). The department consists of a Centre of Expertise (COE) in Amsterdam and two execution locations in Bratislava and Manila that provide services to 26 countries worldwide.
As an Expert Lead, you are responsible for driving the performance and output of a high performing team with each individual bringing unique expertise to the table. You will act as a foreman-style leader, which means hands-on, present on the floor, and actively involved in broader change initiatives. Your primary focus will be on ensuring consistent, high-quality delivery outcomes while fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and adaptability. As a people lead you support the team in their personal development plans, coach and mentor team members, and foster a solution-focused, team-oriented culture that is anchored in our principles and values. You balance leadership with robust delivery and oversight of delivery of your team members by nurturing talent, removing impediments, facilitating cross-functional collaboration, and ultimately driving impactful change.
Your team plays a pivotal role in design and deployment of enterprise solutions including measures, dynamic reports, and interactive dashboards to track FM (Financial Markets) client P&L and provide various Management information and data analytics insights.
Your key responsibilities include:
Overall accountability for the delivery of your own stories and features and those of the team contributing as one team towards the sustainable and high-quality delivery of changes.
Owning and overseeing the local delivery roadmap, aligning initiatives with strategic objectives, and ensuring stakeholder engagement and team buy-in throughout.
Providing guidance and direction in developing robust and governed data models, data pipelines, and BI solutions, ensuring teams are equipped with a clear understanding of implications and empowered to act decisively.
Supporting a team of 10+ data experts
Performing impact assessments, mobilizing cross-functional teams to evaluate business, operational, and process-level effects, and translating insights into strategic decisions.
Take ownership of the solution design, supporting the team in developing scalable, innovative blueprints that elevate client experience and ensure regulatory compliance.
Driving delivery of high-impact solutions, fostering a culture of excellence, innovation, and accountability across squads to achieve consistent, standardized outcomes.
Overseeing documentation and governance, ensuring requirements, assessments, and solution designs are captured with rigor and endorsed by key stakeholders.
Championing Agile leadership, modeling best practices in stand-ups, refinements, and planning sessions, and cultivating agility and responsiveness across teams.
You support and drive the exploration of how to maximize Data Solution capabilities and utilization for future use cases such as GenAI.
Coordinate efficient and timely enrichment of data required for new regulations, control processes while ensuring optimization of data models
As People and Development Lead, you are entrusted with shaping a thriving, high-impact team by championing growth, alignment, and performance. Your leadership responsibilities include:
Inspiring a culture of continuous learning, actively supporting your team’s personal and professional development through coaching, mentorship, and tailored growth opportunities;
Empowering self-steering and responsibility, coaching your Expertise based Team to operate with autonomy, ownership, and a strong sense of purpose;
Overseeing team deliverables and output, providing strategic oversight of the local backlog to formalize priorities, track progress, and drive meaningful outcomes;
Fostering a collaborative, output driven mindset, leveraging the diverse perspectives from the members in the team to achieve the best possible results;
Leading the full employee lifecycle, including strategic workforce planning, recruitment, development, and performance management—balancing individual aspirations with evolving business needs;
Driving team engagement and motivation, cultivating a positive, inclusive culture that gives a sense of belonging and encourages innovation and resilience;
Translating strategic vision into team-level execution, aligning goals and priorities with departmental and enterprise-wide objectives;
Competencies and Experience:
Proven hands-on experience in PySpark+Python; SQL
Experience in Data modeling, normalization/denormalization, and integrating data across complex systems
8+ years working experience in the international environment and multicultural teams
6+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Data Analytics roles
3+ years of experience in leading and guiding own team is a must criterium for being successful
Agile mindset and practical experience with agile frameworks
Financial Markets or Finance experience advantages
Team player with good communication skills (Fluent in English) and experienced in working in an international environment.
Proactive, hands on - can-do mentality, on top of your delivery (no surprises) and positive mind-set
The ability to facilitate decision-making to drive complex design issues to a conclusion.
Strong organizational sensitivity: ability to understand and consider the underlying issues, opportunities and dynamics of an international organisation with multiple functional and hierarchical lines, dealing with multiple (sometimes conflicting) interests.
A strong resilience: the ability to navigate through ambiguity and simplify complexity without losing essence.
Wage (gross):4.395 EUR/month
